req.title: Delete player
req.statement: The system shall delete the specified player and respond with HTTP 204 when DELETE /players/{playerId} is called.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should delete a player and return HTTP 204. The test suite includes a positive test to verify successful deletion, a negative test to handle non-existent player deletion, and a boundary test to check behavior with the smallest valid squad number.

tests.name: test_delete_existing_player
preconditions: A player with squad number 10 exists in the system.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Precondition: Create a player with squad number 10
player_data = {
    "first_name": "John",
    "last_name": "Doe",
    "squad_number": 10,
    "position": "Forward"
}
client.post("/players/", json=player_data)

# Action: Delete the player with squad number 10
response = client.delete("/players/squadnumber/10")

# Expected: HTTP 204 response
assert response.status_code == 204

tests.name: test_delete_non_existent_player
preconditions: No player with squad number 999 exists in the system.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Action: Attempt to delete a non-existent player with squad number 999
response = client.delete("/players/squadnumber/999")

# Expected: HTTP 404 response
assert response.status_code == 404

tests.name: test_delete_boundary_squad_number
preconditions: A player with squad number 1 exists in the system.
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

# Precondition: Create a player with squad number 1
